notes.title: UFO UPDATE, BETTER RACES!
notes.content: [p]This update adds the UFO to the game![/p][p] Quests Experience has been Updated: Dynamic Difficulty and Camera is different while on quest![/p][p]Other Bug fixes[/p]

notes.title: Update: SUPERCARS and BETTER FIRST PERSON
notes.content:
Improved All Dashboards! Now they are now lower and redesigned for better visibility
Removed Blur in First person mode, making experience better.

Added 3 New Supercars!
-Mclauren
-Lanbo
-Challenga

notes.title: MEGA TRUCK AND MINI TRUCK UPDATE
notes.content:
Added Mini Truck and Mega Truck
Removed Christmas Presents

notes.title: HOLIDAY UPDATE: 2x Better FPS, Christmas Presents, Better Graphics Settings
notes.content: This update makes EarthKart run 2x better on most PCs. The new in game graphics settings allow for fine tuning to make the EarthKart experience enjoyable on any spec PC. Added Exploding Gifts for Christmas too!

notes.title: Huge Graphics OverHaul Update, and Pumpkins!
notes.content: This update overhauls all graphics, with 100x more render distance than possible before. New settings for fog, motion blur, depth of field. Also added pumpkins, refreshed UI, and made game more polished.

notes.title: Urban Adventure Update: Pedestrians, Rings, and Cloud Sync
notes.content:
Updates:
Added Pedestrians to Run over.
Added Checkpoint Rings for ground and sky vehicles.
Added Score and Timer.
Fixed bug where EarthKart Premium would not sync between computers.

notes.title: Click to Teleport, Safe Zones, Improved Zombies Mode
notes.content:
This update adds ease of use features, quality of life updates. and fixes game breaking bugs.

Added Safe zones for easier upgrade access (no steep ramps)

Player can now left click to get unstuck while on rough terrain.

Fixed waypoint glitches at far distance

Fixed items spawning too close to player

Updated tutorials

notes.title: Improved Upgrade Stations, Performance Improvements, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Improved Upgrade Stations
Zombies no longer spawn when upgrading
Optimized Game to clear Cache for better performance
Fixed loading crash
Fixed crash when too far above world
Fixed crash when doing donuts in plane
Disabled portal for zombies mode
Disabled meteor for flying vehicles

notes.title: The Vehicle Upgrades Update
notes.content:
This Update Brings Tons of new Features!

Left and Right Mounted side Turrets
Flamethrower
Spikes
Temporary top turret

Zombies:
Waves are now time based

More Features: 
Arrow Key Control
New tutorials for newbies
Restore Purchases

notes.title: EarthKart: Zombies, The Guns Update
notes.content:
This update adds randomly spawning guns. Blast zombies to your hearts content.
You can use guns in 3 ways
1. Find a machine gun item in the world 
2. Break a crate to find gun
3. Build your own sentry turret

Zombies updates: 
Added giants
Added medkits
Balanced waves

Loot crates for variety

The store is back to offering coin sales.

notes.title: The Waypoints Update
notes.content: Added Random Waypoints to spice up gameplay, now instead of aimlessly driving you have somewhere to go!

notes.title: Update 1.7 Trucks Update
notes.content:
This updates adds much needed features you have all been requesting.
Refreshed and Clean UI
5 Fully new vehicles
Enhanced Plane with First Person
Improved First Person for all vehicles
Better Dashboard
New Vehicle Selection Menu
Overall simplification for easy play

notes.title: Update 1.6 is Here! Endless First Person and Plane!
notes.content: I have heard all of your feedback, You can now drive in First Person and Fly Plane as long as you would like! No more timers or cooldowns. I have also improved servers again, added address safeguards, and updated throw egg to E, fixed sound settings, there is plenty to enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.5: One Time Purchase and Server Updates!
notes.content: This update was definitely needed, adding a one time purchase to get coins everyday, and now 3X the amount of server traffic will be supported, if the map was not loading for you previously, it should load for you now.

notes.title: Update 1.4 is Here! Free Unlimited Gas!
notes.content: Unlimited Gas is here! No more annoying Gas Tanks! Users now get 2 free Sessions per day with Unlimited Driving instead of 1 tank of gas. Please give me feedback so I can Improve this further!
